input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: No MFN or best-terms obligation binds Customer. Section 12.3 expressly disclaims any most-favoured-customer commitment, and the pricing provisions (7.1 fixed Fees, 8.3 capped renewal uplift) contain no obligation for us to match or extend third-party terms. No redline required.

input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory.
input.rationale: There is no non-solicitation or no-hire provision binding Customer anywhere in the Agreement; a full-text search for "solicit", "no-hire" and "induce" returned only Section 12.3, which affirmatively preserves our right to hire via general recruitment and confirms no no-hire commitment. This matches our preferred position, so no redline.

input.quote: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty days' prior written notice to Vendor. Customer owes Fees only for conforming Services provided through the effective termination date, and Vendor shall promptly refund prepaid Fees allocable to the period after that date. Vendor has no corresponding convenience-termination right during a committed term.
input.rationale: Section 9.4 matches our preferred position exactly: 30 days' notice, pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, no penalty, and no reciprocal Vendor convenience right during a committed term. The only risk was the Section 2.1 take-or-pay, which would have made the right economically illusory; that is addressed under MINCOMMIT, where our redline expressly subordinates any commitment to Section 9.4.

input.quote: thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Meets the preferred position: automatic 12-month (not multi-year) renewals, a 30-day non-renewal window that only Customer need exercise, a 60-day Vendor reminder with an extension if the reminder is missed, and Section 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3% with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods. No redline.
